exact_terminal_header:
namespace E993FirstShell

theorem registeredFirstOrderShell
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (T : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel T.Adj]
    (hTree : T.IsTree) (p : ℕ)
    (hEarly : C5LA1.crossingIndex T + 2 ≤ p)
    (hAlpha : 3 * p < 2 * T.indepNum + 1)
    (hOrder : Fintype.card V = 2 * p + 2) :
    C5LA1.aggregate T p ≤ 0

end E993FirstShell
terminal_meaning: For every finite ordinary tree T and natural p with x(T)+2<=p, strict 3p<2alpha(T)+1, and |V(T)|=2p+2, the full sum over all original leaves v satisfying Delta_p(T-v)<0 of Delta_(p-1)(T-{v,s_v})-Delta_(p-1)(T-N_T[s_v]) is <=0. The favorable filter and strict alpha guard are retained exactly.
proposed_internal_pointwise_lemma: Under tree, x(T)+2<=p, and |T|=2p+2, every original leaf term is <=0; this stronger assertion has no new award.

mathematical_route.cover_three_exclusion: For every rank 0<=r<=p-2, a cover of T of size <=3 yields Delta_r(T)>0 via the exact cover partition, the Catalan floor with guarded negative indices, binomial-difference monotonicity, and strict Gamma_3 arithmetic; this contradicts x(T)+2<=p.
mathematical_route.leaf_cover_simplification: Any cover of H=T-{v,s} of size <=2 extends with s to a cover of T of size <=3; no alpha(T)-alpha(H) or minimum-cover equality is required.
mathematical_route.marked_route: Single-mark partition plus A (order<=2k), B (order<=2k+1 and >=2 edges), C (order=2k+2, no cover<=2, nonisolated mark); C uses pinned first-wide at r=k-1 in its exact-order branch.
endpoint_checks: Shift t=k+1: integer rank -1 gives E(m,-1)=1.
Shift t>=k+2: integer rank <=-2 gives E(m,j)=0.
r=0 and r=1 three-cover margins are each 2; r>=2 has positive Catalan lower margin.
A nontrivial H component has a W-root nonisolated in H; H cannot be all isolates under no-cover<=2.
